Banning AI will not make it go away.

A 16 year old lifeguard in Santa Cruz rescued a boy from drowning in large breaking waves close to the beach. The same swell, affecting San Diego County has resulted in hundreds of rescues. They say that every year a few people go for a swim at Ocean Beach in San Francisco. By the time they look back land is a lot farther than they expected. They panic and start swimming against the rip current. Not even Michael Phelps would stand a chance.

Yet, many watermen and women use the same currents to make paddling out a breeze.

The barrier to entry for an industrialist was an expensive machine. The barrier to entry for a white collar office worker to benefit from personal computers was an expensive, but affordable machine. The barrier to entry for an entrepreneur to benefit from the internet was an affordable internet connection. Each revolution has been a messy affair, economically, politically, and socially - huge progress and massive destruction. The barrier to entry for a creative person to benefit from AI is nothing.

I have never seen a technology be adopted so quickly by every generation and culture. Whenever I find a use for AI, it so drastically cuts the time to accomplish tasks that I’m left wanting to do more with my (finally copious) free time!

Swimming against the rip will leave you exhausted and helpless. If you are though, then I hope you have a large life preserver.

content_html_zh:
• Home
  • 随笔
  • E-Mail
  • GitHub

禁止人工智能不会让它消失。

圣克鲁斯市一名 16 岁的救生员在海滩附近的巨浪中救出了一名溺水的男孩。 同样的海浪影响了圣地亚哥县，导致数百人获救。 据说每年都有几个人去旧金山的海洋海滩游泳。 当他们回头看时，陆地比他们预期的要远得多。 他们惊慌失措，开始逆着离岸流游泳。 甚至迈克尔·菲尔普斯也没有机会。

然而，许多水手和女水手使用相同的水流使划船变得轻而易举。

实业家的进入壁垒是一台昂贵的机器。 白领办公室职员从个人电脑中受益的障碍是一台昂贵但负担得起的机器。 企业家从互联网中受益的进入障碍是负担得起的互联网连接。 每一次革命在经济、政治和社会上都是一场混乱的事件——巨大的进步和大规模的破坏。 对于一个有创造力的人来说，从人工智能中受益的门槛并不高。

我从未见过一项技术能够如此迅速地被每一代人、每一文化所采用。 每当我发现人工智能的用途时，它都会大大减少完成任务的时间，以至于我想利用我的（终于充裕的）空闲时间做更多的事情！

逆着裂口游泳会让你疲惫不堪、无助。 如果你是的话，那么我希望你有一个大的救生圈。
